Module net.automatalib.util
Package net.automatalib.util.graph.scc

Class TarjanSCCVisitor<N,E>

java.lang.Object
net.automatalib.util.graph.scc.TarjanSCCVisitor<N,E>
Type Parameters:
N - node class
E - edge class
All Implemented Interfaces:
GraphTraversalVisitor<N,E,TarjanSCCRecord>
public class TarjanSCCVisitor<N,E> extends Object implements GraphTraversalVisitor<N,E,TarjanSCCRecord>
Depth-first traversal visitor realizing Tarjan's algorithm for finding all strongly-connected components (SCCs) in a graph, as described in Depth-First Search and Linear Graph Algorithms.
